Everyone back on Earth seems so far away, and my mission log feels endless today. I just want to quit the mission.

Hey, it's okay to feel worn down out here—long-duration crews hit that wall too, and pretending you don't feel tired doesn't help anyone. Take five minutes away from the flight gauges, grab some water, and let's break today down to just one small task. You don't have to finish the whole mission right now—just take the next step with me.
